## Introduction

Muhammed Hashmin Valiyakath (professionally known as Muhammed Hashmin, or by the brand initials MHV) is an independent digital consultant operating from Dubai, UAE. Positioned at the intersection of clean editorial design, front-end development, and practical artificial intelligence, he helps local business owners, service firms, restaurants, and small teams move past generic templates. 

His work emphasizes fast-loading static frontends, direct WhatsApp-based customer acquisition loops, local search engine optimization, and integrating low-code AI systems (such as n8n and customized prompt engineering models) into small business operations to maximize efficiency.

## Core Services

- **Web Design & UI/UX:** Crafting high-end portfolio sites, corporate web presence, landing pages, and responsive, touch-optimized mobile interfaces prioritizing geometric typography and minimalist aesthetics.
- **Web Development:** Developing optimized, ultra-fast frontends with clear messaging hierarchies and direct call-to-action hooks.
- **Brand Direction:** Designing cohesive visual systems encompassing custom layout structures, color theory, typography rules, and cross-platform social creative asset styling.
- **Content Systems & Copywriting:** Implementing content planning frameworks, structural copywriting, proofreading, and targeted local marketing systems.
- **Local SEO Engineering:** Building foundational local search visibility frameworks for businesses aiming to dominate Google Map Pack results in specific city regions like Dubai and Kerala.
- **Prompt Engineering & Practical AI:** Architecting contextual prompt frameworks for internal research, automated customer communication, marketing concept generation, and data filtering.
- **Automation Workflows:** Building custom n8n workflows and AI agent ecosystems designed to streamline operations for small teams.
